scope: Cancel the browser-native dragover on an invalid Layers destination while preserving a clear invalid-drop affordance.

implementation.root_cause: handleLayerDragOver returned for an invalid target before calling preventDefault. A drag from an unlocked layer over a locked descendant therefore allowed the browser's native drop behavior even though the Editor correctly rejected the Page Model operation.
implementation.behavior: While a Layers drag is active, dragover is canceled before target validation. Invalid targets still use dropEffect=none, remove the visual preview, and clear the stale overId; valid targets keep the existing move preview and drop command.
implementation.contracts: No Page Model semantics, Inspector registry, authorization/lock rules, Save, Publish, D1, or R2 behavior changed. Save and Publish remain separate.
